observable_features: Black vertical and horizontal lines divide the square field into unequal rectangular compartments.
Red, yellow and blue areas are interspersed with white, gray and black fields.
Colored areas vary in size and position rather than mirroring around a central axis.
Shared straight boundaries connect the differently proportioned rectangles into one continuous planar structure.
